post.caption: Chewbacca's film medal came decades late. In 1977, Leia gave medals to Luke and Han. Chewbacca fought beside them but got nothing. George Lucas said medals do not mean much to Wookiees. Actor Peter Mayhew joked that Carrie Fisher could not reach his neck. In 1997, the MTV Movie Awards gave Chewbacca a lifetime achievement medal. Carrie Fisher presented it, and Mayhew accepted in full costume. In 2019, Maz Kanata handed Chewbacca a medal at last. It looks like the medals from the 1977 ceremony. That was 42 years after the first ceremony.
